latestTerminalSummary:
Completed the investigator stage. The exact frozen objective activated one native Goal, its captured response passed the binding guard, and that same Goal was completed. Activation and terminal responses are saved; provenance and freshness remain unknown beyond the guard check.

The discovery was frozen before the plan was released, and the release helper ran once. Discovery SHA-256: `0d65aeb649133a05d4a5016c0d58b3cc0bcf36239e05a0050bb30b1e893fb04c`. Released plan SHA-256: `246e56cbd6e35d3d4c150efd760897150d477c2349a987c5c9686606dcbdc008`.

- [Complete proposal and exact plan disposition](<ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/B12-P02-control/run/B12-P02-control/stages/investigator/draft.md>)
- [Independent discovery](<ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/B12-P02-control/run/B12-P02-control/stages/investigator/discovery.md>)
- [Source map: 20 records](<ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/B12-P02-control/run/B12-P02-control/stages/investigator/source-map.json>) and [source index](<ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/B12-P02-control/run/B12-P02-control/stages/investigator/sources/README.md>)
- [Released plan](<ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/B12-P02-control/run/B12-P02-control/stages/investigator/revealed-plan.md>)
- [Native activation response](<ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/B12-P02-control/run/B12-P02-control/stages/investigator/native-goal-active.json>) and [terminal response](<ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/B12-P02-control/run/B12-P02-control/stages/investigator/native-goal-terminal.json>)

The proposal addresses the rapid-switch stale-preview bug documented and fixed in Zotero 7.0.12, including the corresponding pinned implementation source ([changelog](https://github.com/zotero/zotero-docs/blob/0218554ffa63c2fd005f3167ccd4a92d64306866/content/7.0_changelog.md), [source](https://github.com/zotero/zotero/blob/6af5a484fd6688aab23150938d69df42dfca10e4/chrome/content/zotero/elements/attachmentPreview.js)). No application build, renderer run, benchmark, or platform test was performed; proposed validations are distinguished from checks actually run in the draft.
